Project Overview

Stitch is a personal full-stack mobile project that turns creator discovery, brand campaigns, mutual matching, messaging, and payment planning into one organized collaboration experience for creators and businesses.

Process

1

Create Profiles

Creators and businesses enter through role-based onboarding so each side can build the profile information needed for useful discovery.

2

Post Campaigns

Businesses can publish campaign details with images, descriptions, goals, dates, and budget context so creators understand the opportunity before starting a conversation.

3

Discover Opportunities

Creators browse campaign cards and businesses review creator profiles, keeping discovery fast, visual, and easier to compare.

4

Create Mutual Matches

The app turns shared interest into a match so both sides know the conversation is worth continuing.

5

Start Messaging

Matched creators and businesses can move from discovery into chat without relying on scattered social messages or cold outreach.

6

Prepare for Release

The project includes product readiness work around reporting, account deletion, subscriptions, Stripe marketplace payments, and app store release requirements.

Description

Stitch is a mobile creator marketplace project built around a simple idea: creators and businesses should be able to find each other, understand the fit, and begin a collaboration from one focused product flow.

Creators can create a profile, show their work, connect social context, set collaboration expectations, and browse campaigns. Businesses can create profiles, post opportunities, discover creators, and continue with matched users through messaging.

Problem Statement

Creator-brand collaboration often starts in scattered places: direct messages, screenshots, social profiles, spreadsheets, and long conversations before either side knows whether the opportunity is a real fit.

Businesses need a cleaner way to find creators who match their campaign goals. Creators need a simpler way to discover paid opportunities, compare them, and move into serious conversations.

Stitch addresses that workflow by making discovery visual and intentional. The app brings profiles, campaigns, matching, and messaging together so both sides can move from interest to collaboration with less friction.

Full Results

The strongest result is a working mobile product foundation for a two-sided creator marketplace. Stitch supports creator and business onboarding, profile management, campaign creation, visual discovery, matching, messaging, reporting, release preparation, and marketplace payment planning.

App Screenshot

Technical Skills

Built with React Native, Expo, EAS, TypeScript, mobile authentication, image upload workflows, role-based onboarding, creator and business profiles, campaign management, swipe and match interactions, messaging, reporting, account deletion, subscription work, Stripe marketplace payment planning, and app store release preparation.
